abstention_rule: an ineligible fixed-family branch is reported as abstention and is not force-fit

all_panel_abstention_accounting.normal_far: reported conditionally on eligible monitors; eligibility is reported separately

analysis_name: U1 family-adaptation ablation on 17 reserved TEP faults
analysis_status: post-freeze secondary ablation specification; Step-22-R primary results already exist

branches.rule: choose the eligible family with largest median Top-5 absolute Hedges g; break exact ties by frozen family priority
use absolute deviation if at least five coordinates pass the unchanged gate; otherwise abstain
use signed level if at least five coordinates pass the unchanged gate; otherwise abstain
choose between eligible signed level and absolute deviation by the unchanged family score and tie rule

candidate_gate: bootstrap 95% CI excludes zero AND within-fault BH q<=0.05 across 260 candidates AND permutation max-|t| FWER-adjusted p<=0.05
control_limit_rule: 95th percentile of normal-validation run maxima, recalibrated separately for each frozen branch
family_eligibility: at least five coordinates pass the unchanged dual gate
interpretation_rule: if adaptive five-family does not materially improve on restricted AD-or-SL or fixed AD, the manuscript must reduce the five-family adaptation claim
multiplicity_for_paired_tests: Holm adjustment across the three simpler branches separately within each endpoint
multiplicity_scope: within each fault across the fixed 5 x 52 candidate universe
paired_test: two-sided Wilcoxon signed-rank with Pratt zeros on common eligible faults
point_metric_name: post-fault threshold occupancy of the accumulated CUSUM statistic
